Good water starts
with a conversation.

You don’t need to know the right system yet. We’ll start with your questions, discuss your home’s water, and help you understand what to consider next.

  1. 01

    Tell us about your water

    Tell us what you’ve noticed, which taps are affected, and whether your water comes from a utility or private well. Share your city or ZIP code so service coverage can be confirmed.

    Helpful to have
    Your main concern, water source, and any existing system’s model.
  2. 02

    Test. Understand. Explore.

    Ask about the free in-home consultation and water test. Discuss what the test includes, what the results mean, and whether additional testing would be useful for your concerns.

    Questions to ask
    Which findings matter for my goals? What options and installation details should I consider?
  3. 03

    Choose your next step

    Review the proposed system, its specific capabilities, installation scope, and pricing. Ask about replacement filters and maintenance so you can make a considered decision.

    Before you decide
    Understand the written recommendation, model details, total scope, and ongoing care.

Keep care in the picture

The right care.
From day one.

A thoughtful water plan looks beyond installation. These six details help you prepare for filter replacement and ongoing care.

01

Identify your system

Keep the brand, model number, and installation details handy. A clear photo of the label can help start the conversation.

02

Match replacement filters

Check the exact cartridge specification for your model before choosing a replacement. Similar-looking filters may have different requirements.

03

Follow the right schedule

Ask about the manufacturer’s replacement guidance and how your water use may affect the care your system needs.

04

Understand ongoing costs

Discuss replacement-filter pricing and any service needs alongside the initial system recommendation, so you can plan ahead.

05

Keep a simple care record

Save the model details and the dates filters are changed. A small record gives you a useful starting point for the next service discussion.

06

Know who to contact

Have questions about an existing system? Share the details you have and ask about compatible filters, service options, and availability.

Already have a system? Start with the details you have.

A little more clarity

Good questions.
Clear answers.

From the first water test to everyday filter care. Here’s a useful place to start.

Let’s talk about your waterStart with a free consultation
01Do I need whole-house filtration or a drinking-water system?+

A whole-house system addresses water at the main supply, while a drinking-water system treats water at a specific point of use. The right starting point depends on your water source, test results, goals, and the system’s verified capabilities.

02Is the water consultation and test free?+

Florida Pure Solutions’ current offer is a free, no-obligation in-home consultation and water test. Ask about service coverage, what the test includes, and any additional testing needs when arranging your visit.

03How much will a system cost?+

System and installation pricing depend on the equipment and your home. A consultation helps establish the right scope before you review a quote. This demo does not provide installation prices or financing terms.

04Will one filter solve every water concern?+

No single treatment solves every concern. Ask which specific substances a proposed model is independently certified to reduce, and follow its maintenance instructions. Appearance, taste, and smell do not establish water safety. Read EPA’s home filtration guidance (opens a new tab).

05Do you serve my part of Florida?+

Share your city or ZIP code when you call to confirm coverage. Local installation and appointment availability need to be confirmed for your address.

06Can you help with replacement filters?+

Ask about replacement filters and ongoing care. Have your system’s brand, model, and last replacement date ready so compatibility and the recommended schedule can be checked.
